title: Kaathu Vaakula Rendu Kaadhal
desc: Love knocks on the door of Rambo, an unlucky man. However, a dilemma arises when he develops feelings for two women at the same time.

title: Jackpot
desc: Two mischievous grifters stumble upon the secret of a magical vessel from an old lady. Subsequently, they embark on a wild and hilarious adventure to acquire it.

title: Ramleela-Govindudu Andariva
desc: Upset that his son wants to settle in London, Balaraju has a bitter argument with him. Later, his grandson travels to India to mend the relationship between his father and grandfather.

title: Premalu
desc: Having been rejected once, Sachin, a young man, falls for Reenu, a girl he meets during a wedding and sets out to win her over.

title: MGR Magan
desc: An estranged father and son discover shared purpose as they join forces to protect their village's mountain from a ruthless businessman's schemes.

title: Maska
desc: Rumi, a young man, aspires to be an actor but his mother wants him to take over their family business, an Irani cafe. However, he decides to forsake the cafe to pursue his dream.

title: Gouravam
desc: Arjun reaches his friend Shanmughan's village, only to find out that he has eloped with Pasupathy's daughter. So, Arjun, along with his friends and Yazhini, a lawyer, sets out to find the couple.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Nedunchalai
desc: Murugan steals groceries from passing trucks in order to make a living. However, things take a turn when he comes across Masani, a corrupt and perverted inspector.

title: Geetha Govindam
desc: Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.

title: Aan Paavam Pollathathu
desc: A young couple's marriage takes tumultuous turns from the get-go when the husband struggles to accept his wife's modernistic lifestyle.

title: Udanpirappe
desc: Mathangi's husband is a law-abiding citizen while her brother advocates for fighting for justice. As their conflicting beliefs drive them apart, Mathangi struggles to bridge the rift between them.

title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
desc: After learning that his father was brutally killed by Bhallaladeva, Mahendra Baahubali raises an army to defeat him and release his mother from the former's captivity.

title: Draupathi
desc: Accused of his wife's murder in an alleged honor killing, Rudra Prabhakaran is jailed. Subsequently, he descends into a dark path of vengeance after posting bail.
